votes.motion: Approve the listed minutes of previous meetings (December 2, December 16 and January 13).
votes.quote: the commission voted unanimously to approve all minutes by unanimous roll call vote

votes.motion: Approve the Eagle Scout proposal by Bryan Weidman for a kiosk sign at Proctor Park.
votes.quote: kj moved to approve the project. cl seconded and the commission approved the motion by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Approve Central Mass Goat Rental continuing goat hikes on Conservation Land, pending liability certificates, police department notification and DCR verification, with the 21 day requirement waived.
votes.quote: the motion was seconded by jr and was passed by a roll call vote unanimously.

votes.motion: Approve the application as presented for Christopher Oldham's request for determination at 32 Pine Grove Road (tree removal).
votes.quote: kj seconded and the commission voted unanimously to approve the motion by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Continue the Fire Road 12 Notice of Intent hearing (Tom Wu and Scott Benjamin) to February 15, 2021 at 7 PM.
votes.quote: continued to the february 15, 2021 meeting at 7 pm by a motion of jr and a second by cc

votes.motion: Continue the meeting on the Proctor Masonry Notice of Intent at 203 Fire Road 16 until later within the meeting.
votes.quote: kj moved to continue the meeting until later within the meeting. the motion was seconded by rb

votes.motion: Continue the Proctor Masonry Notice of Intent hearing at 203 Fire Road 16 to February 17.
votes.quote: kj moved to continue the meeting to february 17 with a second by cl and a unanimous vote to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Approve an Order of Conditions for Rich Pierson's septic replacement at 75 Ruth Street, with the added condition of two replacement tree plantings.
votes.quote: jr moved to approve an order of conditions with the additional condition of replacing the trees removed with 2 added tree plantings

votes.motion: Continue the Proctor Masonry Notice of Intent hearing at 36 Cushing Lane to February 17.
votes.quote: kj moved to continue the meeting to february 17 with a second by rb and a unanimous vote to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Ratify the enforcement order for 615 Townsend Street.
votes.quote: kj moved to ratify the order. cc seconded and the commission voted unanimously

votes.motion: Issue the formal enforcement letter regarding Fire Road 16.
votes.quote: cl moved to issue the formal enforcement letter. jr seconded and the commission approve the roll call vote unanimously.

votes.motion: Issue the Certificate of Compliance for 63 Prospect Street.
votes.quote: kj moved to issue the certificate. cl second and the commission approved the motion by unanimous

votes.motion: Release the Order of Conditions for 21 Crescent Terrace on the expired order (1994 project never commenced).
votes.quote: the commission voted to approve the release of the order of conditions by a motion of kj and a second by jr

votes.motion: Approve a one year extension of DEP 208-1104 Hickory Hills Lake, to take effect after the COVID-19 declaration is lifted.
votes.quote: the motion to approve was approved by a split roll call vote by kj, cc, jr and bp and no by cl and rb.
the meeting was adjourned at 10:25 pm by a motion of cc and a second by kj
